what: On open, a background-color curtain covers the screen for 1s, then lifts in .2s. From that moment the Sections appear after a .3s delay over .3s (ease-out), the surrounding frame and guides come in after 1s, and the floating apply button slides in from the right by its own width after 1.2s. It is a campaign landing page load where the curtain lifts and the screen switches on in order. The ‹shrink› type: an accent-color curtain stays attached to the top edge and folds to height 0 (the bottom edge rises), fading midway, while Sections float up from 16px below. It is a commemorative site opening where a red curtain lifts and the first screen rises in order.

options.hold: Seconds the curtain stays covering, default 1 — shorten for screens opened often like apps (0 lifts it right away)
options.delay: Delay after the curtain starts lifting until content appears (seconds), default .3 — change per child with data-delay
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: Curtain that covers then lifts (child, without it, only the fade-in appears)
options.[data-fx-part=show]: Appear in sequence (multiple children) — data-delay="1" Delay it with, and data-dur="2" Changing the length via, data-from="right" Slides in from the right at the plane’s own width, with data-from="top" Drops in from above by its own height
options.fx:done: When the last one appears, the element fires this event
options.look: With ”shrink” the curtain doesn’t fade but collapses in height to 0 over veil seconds while stuck to the top edge, and fades over fade seconds starting fade-at seconds after the collapse begins. Curtain color is --kf-accent
options.fade-at: When the curtain starts to fade in the shrink type (seconds, after folding begins), default .5
options.fade: Duration (s) of the veil fading out in the shrink type, default .6
options.rise: Distance it floats up from below on appearing (px), default 0 — Brand 16
options.--fx-veil: Curtain color (via style), default var(--kf-bg) — Brand uses a pale accent-color curtain
